caption:
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

Surah Ad-Duha (93:3). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #AdDuha #Hope #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 93:3, Surah Ad-Duha: short single ayah of reassurance. Slug not previously used by any published post on this channel (checked against all 31 existing meta.json files).
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live-fetched 2026-09-30, HTTP 200, single call api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/93:3/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih. Slide text extracted programmatically from the API response and asserted byte-identical to the on-disk slide JSON. No formatting artifacts.
sourcing.english: Edition en.sahih (Saheeh International), same live call. Extracted programmatically, asserted byte-identical. Source text contains bracketed translator insertions [O Muhammad] and [you], kept as-is.
sourcing.chinese: Edition zh.jian (Ma Jian translation), same live call. Extracted programmatically, asserted byte-identical.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, same live call. Edition metadata lists englishName 'Unknown' for the translator, so the citation slide reads 'translator not specified by source'. Extracted programmatically, asserted byte-identical.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, same live call. Same 'Unknown' translator metadata, same citation wording. Extracted programmatically, asserted byte-identical.
sourcing.malay: Edition ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), same live call. Extracted programmatically, asserted byte-identical.
sourcing.verification_note: All six editions fetched in one API call this session (HTTP 200); every slide text written directly from the raw response fields and re-read from disk and asserted equal before this record was written. No wording generated from memory. Caption pull-quote is the en.sahih text.
